Question 6
?

Which of the following represents the shaded region above as a type II region in two-dimensional space?

a
D={(x,y):1≤y≤2,0≤x≤ey+1}
b
D={(x,y):1≤y≤2,0≤x≤ln⁡y+1}
c
D={(x,y):1≤y≤e,0≤x≤ey+1}
d
D={(x,y):1≤y≤e,0≤x≤ln⁡y+1}
e
D={(x,y):1≤y≤2,0≤x≤ey−1}
Submit
